crossRefs.note: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter…
A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”
One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is…
